Pokémon Evolved Hub

Gen 1 engine, the Emerald ROM hack, and the Evolved species data — in one place, each on its own tab.

One repository, three tracks: the Gen 1 engine you can play right now, the Emerald ROM hack this project started as, and the Evolved species data shared between them. Each has its own tab — nothing was overwritten to fit them together.

No ROMs are included here — by design

Both engines require game content you already own. gen1recomp verifies your Red/Blue/Yellow cartridge dump by SHA-1 at import time and releases it from memory afterwards; the Emerald decomp builds against your own Emerald ROM. Nothing in this repository ships game data.

How the merge is laid out

The repo root stays a clean pokeemerald decompilation — the Emerald build is untouched. gen1recomp is vendored under engines/gen1recomp rather than flattened into the root, because both projects define src/, tools/, data/ and assets/ with incompatible contents; overlaying them would break the Emerald build outright. See engines/VENDOR.md.

Generation 1 — Red / Blue / Yellow

Playable now

A native LÖVE2D recreation of Pokémon Red, Blue and Yellow. The engine and map behaviour are hand-written Lua; game data and graphics are decoded from a ROM you supply. This is the one you can play outright today — no emulator, no ROM patching.

Engine
gen1recomp — LÖVE2D (Lua)
Location
engines/gen1recomp

Launch

macOS./Play.sh gen1or double-click engines/gen1recomp/Play-Mac.command
Linux./Play.sh gen1needs love 11.x on PATH
WindowsPlay.bat gen1or double-click engines/gen1recomp/Play-Windows.bat

Steps

  1. Run the launcher for your platform.
  2. On first boot, pick your legally obtained .gb / .gbc file or drop it onto the window.
  3. Import takes a few seconds, then the game starts automatically.
  4. Later launches load the generated cache and never ask for the ROM again.

You supply the game content

Only the canonical 1 MiB US ROMs are accepted. The importer verifies SHA-1 before creating any game data, uses the ROM during import, then releases it from memory — it is never copied into the cache.

Generation 3 — Emerald: Evolved Starters

Builds a ROM

The original work in this repository: an Emerald ROM hack that extends the three Kanto starter lines with the official Pokémon Evolved expansion data plus our own DIY alternate branches. It builds a real .gba from the decompiled source at the repo root.

Engine
pret/pokeemerald decompilation — C + ARM assembly
Location
.

Launch

Any./Play.sh emeraldopens the evolution showcase

Steps

  1. python3 tools/bootstrap_evolved_starters.py — apply starter species + evolution patches.
  2. cd tools && npm install canvas && node generate_sprites.mjs — optional DIY sprites.
  3. make tools -j$(nproc) then make -j$(nproc) — needs devkitARM + libpng.
  4. Output: pokeemerald.gba

You supply the game content

Building links against a legally obtained US Emerald ROM. No ROM is distributed here.

Future generations & the Emerald recomp

Planned

Where the next engines slot in. gen1recomp is vendored not just to be playable, but as a working reference for giving Emerald the same treatment — a native engine that reads a user-supplied ROM instead of patching one.

Emerald, recomp-style

Planned

Apply gen1recomp's architecture to Gen 3: verify a user-supplied Emerald ROM by SHA-1, decode data and graphics into a cache, and drive it from a hand-written engine. The Evolved starter lines then become engine data rather than ROM patches — editable without a rebuild.

engines/gen1recomp/src/import — the ROM import and decode pipeline to model this on.

Generation 2 — Gold / Silver / Crystal

Planned

The nearest neighbour to the Gen 1 engine; much of the map, battle and save handling in engines/gen1recomp/src generalises to the Gen 2 formats.

Register it in apps/hub/engines.json and it appears as a tab automatically.

Evolved species beyond the starters

In progress

hack/species.json currently covers the three Kanto starter lines in both the official Evolved and DIY branches. It is the single source of truth for the Species tab and is designed to grow to the full roster.

hack/species.json

Shared asset pipeline

Planned

One sprite and species pipeline feeding every engine, so a species defined once renders in the Gen 1 engine, the Emerald build, and the hub.

tools/generate_sprites.mjs, tools/bootstrap_evolved_starters.py
